deviations.detail: First MATLAB runner launch failed to parse multi-line struct calls because continuation ellipses were missing. Added ellipses in new runner and unrun mixed-model reporting script. No bout was analyzed before the parser error; method code and settings unchanged. Original log regional_bouts_matlab.log retained.

Second runner launch could not find included after automatic CSV import detection. Fixed comma delimiter, first-row headers, UTF-8, preserved variable names and explicit boolean interpretation. No bout analyzed before failure; original attempt2 log retained.

Third launch resolved the legacy one-output bst_apc in the process current folder ahead of addpath entries; call rejected with too many outputs before any method computation. Set analysis folder as current directory, clear function cache, and assert both method and metric resolve to frozen_v1 copies. No tagged source edited; no bout result existed before fix.
